rationale: C16 is a strong plausible template because it is an earlier presidential letter urging congressional action on the same National Cultural Center. The child adapts C16's compact structure—identify the pending legislative need, explain the Center's national importance and role in the performing arts, and urge prompt congressional action—to the later need for enlarging the federally provided site. The overlap is substantially more concrete than generic legislative-request correspondence. C15 resembles the child's renewal of an earlier recommendation, while C07 has a similar short congressional-appeal structure, but neither shares the distinctive subject matter and supporting language found in C16.

shared_material.child_excerpt: legislation to enlarge the site of the proposed National Cultural Center in Washington. Under the National Cultural Center Act, the site for the Center is to be provided by the federal government.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: legislation now pending before your Committee which would authorize the establishment of a National Cultural Center here in Washington on a site made available by the federal Government
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the requested congressional action around the same Center, its Washington location, and a federally provided site.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is a real and promising opportunity to establish new horizons for the performing arts in this city.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There has long been a need for more adequate facilities in the Nation's capital for the presentation of the performing arts.
shared_material.explanation: The child reworks the parent's distinctive performing-arts justification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The National Cultural Center is the most significant cultural undertaking in the history of this city and has enormous importance to the cultural life of the nation as a whole.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: an auditorium and other facilities such as are provided for in pending legislation ... would be a center of which the entire Nation could be proud
shared_material.explanation: Both elevate the Center from a local Washington project to an undertaking of national cultural significance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I urge the early enactment of this legislation so that the plans for the National Cultural Center may proceed promptly.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that the Congress will complete action on this legislation during this session.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by pressing Congress for prompt completion of the Center legislation.
